models.label: SpotUNet anyscale8 peaked+sharpened (scale-robust, bundled)
models.notes: spotunet_anyscale8_peaked_sharpened from yoloDiffraction: the anyscale8_peaked scale-robust base (base8, levels=3; trained across disk sizes, so it tolerates residual scale error after the canonical rescale) with the sharpened offset head grafted on. Best current all-rounder on real 4D-STEM (ZrNb/CuNb/SPED-Ag truth benchmark, 2026-07-16); parameter-free with auto-calibration.

models.label: SpotUNet production (bundled)
models.notes: SRO-augmented edge-decoupled detector; best on CuNb/ZrNb/SPED-Ag, parameter-free with auto-calibration. Beats WNCC on crystalline 4D-STEM. Slightly higher crystal recall than anyscale8 on canonical-size disks; weaker off its trained scale.

models.label: SpotUNet base16 (legacy)
models.notes: Earlier edge-trained detector. Kept as a fallback.

models.label: Centre network F5 (bundled; the refine step)
models.notes: The refine step. Segments each disk in a 33 px window of the raw frame (spot radius -> 10 window px) and takes the coverage centroid; re-crops disks the first pass moved by more than 0.15 R; its sigma head is calibrated per checkpoint (sigma_scale 0.98). On real GaN it lowers the Friedel error of the detector's centres from 1.13 to 0.84 px. Skipped below a 5 px spot radius.

models.label: Friedel-partner network P4 (bundled; the step on top of F5)
models.notes: The refine step's layout reading two channels: the disk's own window and the window at its Friedel mirror point 2 x beam - p (rotated 180 degrees), so it sees both dynamical fills of g and -g. The beam is each frame's centre of Friedel symmetry, from the incoming centres. Trained on disks of 6-16 px radius; outside that range it leaves the incoming centres alone (below 6 px a version trained smaller made in-grain speckle worse).
